fact: CEPICI says it launched the online company-creation service E-ENTREPRISE in October 2018, via the 225invest.ci portal.
CEPICI states that firms can be created online through the E-Entreprise platform on the 225Invest portal, where creators complete their formalities.

CEPICI states that the Identifiant Unique (IDU), operational since 2018, is now the one number a firm needs with every administration, registering it with the commercial register, the tax authority and the social security fund (CNPS).
